name: Focus Lumber Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未公告任何业务板块的产能扩张、新业务进入、缩减或出售事项；所披露的公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会、股息除权及公司地址变更等常规企业事项。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any capacity expansion, new business entry, reduction, or divestment in its business segments; the announcements disclosed were mainly routine corporate matters such as quarterly results, general meetings, dividend ex-date, and change of address.
